tasks.title: 301 Redirect /suite-rentals/ to /open-your-salon/ + Fix 3,216 Missing Trailing-Slash Template Links (NEW-10, Item 36.0, NEW-06)
tasks.rootCause:
1. SYMPTOM & LIVE EVIDENCE: (A) https://imagestudios.co/suite-rentals/ returns HTTP 404 Not Found in production. (B) Screaming Frog flagged 3,216 internal 301 redirects (45.51% of crawled URLs): 2,862 are /pros/[slug] links and 354 are /bios/[slug] and location links missing a trailing slash (/).
2. ROOT CAUSE: Legacy /suite-rentals/ URL lacks a 301 rule after consolidation into /open-your-salon/, and PHP templates output anchor hrefs without trailingslashit().
tasks.businessImpact: Recovers link equity on the legacy /suite-rentals/ commercial URL and eliminates 3,216 unnecessary internal 301 redirect hops in a single template update.
tasks.technicalInstructions:
1. In Nginx / Yoast Redirects, add permanent 301 redirect:
   rewrite ^/suite-rentals/?$ https://imagestudios.co/open-your-salon/ permanent;
2. In /wp-content/themes/image-studios/ templates (single-studio_locations.php, page-locations.php), wrap dynamic profile and location links in trailingslashit():
   <a href="<?php echo esc_url( trailingslashit( $pro_url ) ); ?>">
acceptanceCriteria: All /pros/, /bios/, and location links in DOM include a trailing slash (/).
